About Us: 
 20 years on the Romanian IT market and still growing.
 Part of the HN Services Group, with offices in France, Spain, Portugal, and Luxembourg, HN Services Romania is about building real careers, not just filling roles . 
 What you’ll find here: 
Digital transformation projects with real impact
A wide range of technical roles across modern and legacy technologies (yes, COBOL is still very much alive)
Exposure to diverse industries and international environments
Continuous growth through our in-house software development training center (HN Training Institute)
 💡We are currently looking for a Data Scientist who is responsible for onboarding new document types and data points, improving extraction quality and supporting the reliable operation of AI analytical components. The role combines data analysis, model development, evaluation, prompt optimization and collaboration with business and technical stakeholders across countries.
 Key focus areas: 
Onboarding of new document types and new data points.
Data extraction solutions and confidence-score mechanisms.
Prompt tuning, model optimization and continuous improvement.
Quality monitoring, performance evaluation and production maintenance.
Country integration support and progressive industrialization of the AI-based platform.
 Main responsibilities: 
Analyze and explore labelled and production data to understand document structures, data quality and extraction behaviour.
Perform first-level quality assurance of labelled datasets; identify inconsistencies and coordinate corrections with business stakeholders.
Prepare, train, evaluate and improve extraction solutions for new document types and new data points.
Build and enhance data-extraction components, including confidence-score calculation and validation.
Investigate failed or low-confidence values, identify root causes and update rules, prompts or datasets as appropriate.
Calculate and interpret quality metrics for each data point and document type; communicate findings and recommended improvements.
Tune and optimize prompts used in OCR, document understanding or GenAI-supported processing.
Produce and optimize Python-based analytical models and tools, with attention to scalability, resource usage and maintainability.
Ensure that code, datasets, assumptions, evaluation results and operational procedures are clearly documented and production-ready.
Support recurring production runs and contribute to automation, monitoring and incident investigation together with the Support Engineer and partner teams.
Contribute to country integrations and the onboarding of additional document types, while reusing common components whenever possible.
Ensure model outputs are interpretable; identify potential bias, quality limitations and performance gaps in relation to business needs.
Participate actively in Agile ceremonies, backlog refinement, peer reviews and knowledge-sharing activities.
 Ways of working: 
Work within one shared product backlog, one sprint goal and shared ownership across the IRIS Product Squad.
Collaborate closely with the CoE AI Core Team, country stakeholders and relevant IT teams, with clear escalation to Level 3 expertise when required.
Maintain clear documentation, transparent status reporting and a strong focus on service quality, delivery and continuous improvement.
 What we are looking for: 
Degree in Information Technology, Computer Engineering, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics or a related field.
At least 3 years of relevant experience in data science, machine learning, data analytics or intelligent document processing.
Hands-on experience developing, evaluating and maintaining data-driven solutions in a production-oriented environment.
Experience collaborating with business users, developers, support teams and distributed international stakeholders.
Fluency in English; another European language is an advantage.
 Technical and professional skills: 
Strong Python programming and scripting skills.
Sound knowledge of machine learning, statistical analysis, quantitative evaluation and experiment design.
Experience with data preparation, labelling quality checks, model evaluation metrics and error analysis.
Knowledge of OCR, document AI, information extraction, prompt engineering or GenAI-based processing is a strong advantage.
Knowledge of Git, CI/CD practices, Jira or equivalent Agile tools.
Experience with SQL, relational databases, ETL processes and BI or visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau is desirable.
Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, communication, collaboration, adaptability, initiative and delivery focus.
 📍Location: Bucharest 
 🏢Work type: hybrid, 2x/week 
 *Only eligible candidates will be contacted for further information and start of the recruitment process.
